done_when: forge sync writes every generated file in any worktree, whatever other worktrees hold, and never refuses for another worktree's spec

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The multi-worktree test removes and verifies only the Claude and Codex guides (lines 35–41). It would pass if sync failed to write another generated file in that condition, so it does not prove the stated “every generated file” result. The missing-starting-commit case in tests/test_spec_chat_upgrade_amendment.py returns at line 101 after checking the warning; it never runs the next read, so it would also pass if the promised reader chat recovery broke.
findings.title: Not done: the command-level sync proof

why: forge sync still refuses in a worktree when another worktree holds a copy of a spec, so builders copy the guide by hand into both host skill files
